theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgi_blowUp_gaussGreen_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)) (x : Rn (n + 1)) (r : ℝ), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → 0 < r → ∀ g : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ blowUpMap x r '' U → ∫ z in blowUpMap x r '' E, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g z = -((r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, inner ℝ (g (blowUpMap x r y)) (ν y) ∂μ)
